LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSm:
This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST here before.
Well, guess what? Today, I made it win a SMARTNESS CONTEST!
My abilities scare even me…
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBun:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, so I'm seeing how things work.
If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, cool moves go over as appeals.
But smart moves and cute moves don't go over well, for instance.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonE:
That young man who won earlier had a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S.
Can you win if you had that many of those things?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPl:
Whoa, isn't this place humongous!
The tension in the air… It's not like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBest:
MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their TRAINERS, are you ready?!
Give it your best showing! Let's appeal!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjo:
JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?
Come back with three friends, and all of you may enter a CONTEST!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWro:
Ayayayay… I entered the wrong CONTEST.
I entered this tough POKéMON in the SMARTNESS CONTEST…
Come on, wow them with a smart-looking ROCK SMASH.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonT:
I've spent many a year, and all my wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON to be smart.
It won't be easily bested by some young pup's POKéMON.
My dear wife, are you seeing this?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPulls:
There it is!
If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, the audience's excitement will peak!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontApprec:
Oh, dear, no!
My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so cute I kept using it over and over!
But these mean people don't appreciate it at all!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToU:
Even when TRAINERS enter the same kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use different moves for appeals.
It's just like the way people have different styles for battling.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSma: I think the POKéMON look smarter than their TRAINERS. By a lot.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveS:
When all's said and done, I still love SMARTNESS CONTESTS.
That intellectual green color… It's so… So… Cool.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnte: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY CONTEST, too? Good luck!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokem:
JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a model of pristine beauty!
Why, I almost forgot to score them!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBe:
A POKéMON this beautiful… There isn't another one like it.
Everyone's eyes will be glued to my beauty.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGro:
Waaaah!
I brushed and groomed my POKéMON carefully for this CONTEST…
But I overdid it… My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly…
What should I do?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontS:
This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, the JUDGE won't be able to see it.
Uh, wait a second… That'll be meaningless, then!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLoo:
This pretty POKéMON looks just like me when I was younger.
Right when I said that, my husband spewed the coffee he was drinking.
Did I say something funny?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyC: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me happy. More than usual, anyway.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAl:
Wahahahah!
Will you take a gander at all those pretty POKéMON! I just love this sort of glitz!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnB:
You can't always win on just beauty alone.
You have to groom your POKéMON so it's nice and glossy like mine.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddl:
MC: Uh-oh! Hello! We're in the middle of a CONTEST!
Please enter at our registration counter and come out, okay?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmi:
JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute appeals!
Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly adorable WATER SPORT appeal!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillW: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was distracted by another POKéMON.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBa: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, but put it in a CONTEST and look out!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDance:
My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel of elegance.
I won't let anyone disturb its performance.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppea:
Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.
However, if my POKéMON were to make a cute appeal…
I'm sure that it would be so much  cuter than the others.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsI: My child is in this CONTEST.
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear: Come on, dear. Go for it! Your POKéMON is the best!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlTh:
I think that girl over there is the cutest of the lot.
What's that? They're judging POKéMON by their looks?
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMo:
Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, they make we want to get my own!
I'm going to go catch some!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyCont: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContes: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!
LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartConte: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!
